TEXT: [FI] Pulled along by Saori, we ended up in...
[FI] Maid café "Pretty Garden".
[FI] The usual place that we often hang out at...
[FI] As well as the place that Saori and I first met.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] We're meeting your benefactor here?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes. I made a reservation.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm.
[FI] Someone that resembles Saori Bajeena, huh...
[FI] I wonder what kind of person would show up.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAID
TEXT: [FI] Welcome~♪

SPEAKER: SPK_MAID
TEXT: [FI] Is it just the two of you for today?
[FI] This person is Hoshino Kirara.
[FI] A maid who works at this cafe.
[FI] Don't tell me, she is Saori's benefactor...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I have a reservation under Saori Bajeena.
[FI] Doesn't look like that's the case.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT: [FI] Certainly, Lieutenant Bajeena♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT:
[FI] Please follow me to your seats. Your companion is 
waiting for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey Saori, does she mean...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Fufufu... Looks like we've kept someone waiting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT: [FI] Now then, this way please.

[FI] Following Kirara's lead, when we arrived at our 
seats...
[FI] There was a little girl waiting for us.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Yaho~!
[FI] This cute little girl... is Saori's benefactor?

[FI] At first glance, all I can see is an elementary school 
girl...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I am repentant for the wait. It has been a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT:
[FI] It sure has! We last met around... two Summer 
Comikets ago?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes. Have you been well?

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Naturally~♪ I've been super!

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] That's my only redeeming trait, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Again with your jokes.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] There aren't many who possess the amount of 
great traits you have.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Geez, you think too much of me.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT:
[FI] Heh... I am, after all, the smallest here at Pretty 
Garden.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Just kidding♪
[FI] This frivolous personality...
[FI] and that appearance of an elementary school girl...
[FI] I remember seeing her before.
[FI] But... two Summer Comikets ago...
[FI] Was that what she said?
[FI] I feel that it was somewhere else instead...
[FI] Ah crap. I had it on the tip of my tongue.
[FI] Well, at least she doesn't resemble "Saori Bajeena".
[FI] Not in her speech, personality, or outfit.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] That aside~, Saori-shi~

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Is that the guy you wanted to introduce me to?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Yes indeed. The whole purpose of today was to get 
you two to meet.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] *cough* Now then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] This is Kousaka Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Fufun~, my boyfriend.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey there.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=26]E[/font_size][font_size=24]h[/font_size]--!　[font_size=33]Really!?[/font_size] Really [font_size=28]really!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Saori-chan's boyfriend!

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=26]No way, no way! Wow-!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Whaaaaaaaaa~~
[FI] This is one high-spirited kid.

[FI] Isn't Saori's benefactor, around the level of a high 
schooler...

[FI] Elementary... I was expecting at least a middle 
schooler.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Not bad, not bad. He's definitely my type.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I won't give him to you, y'know?

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Kay~.

[FI] She's not exactly my type, but she's still pretty 
gorgeous.

[FI] When a cute girl calls me her "type", I can't help 
but get excited.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Now then Kyousuke-shi. I'll introduce her to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] This is Kurusu Kanata-san. She is an old 
acquaintance as well as my precious benefactor.
[FI] Saori used "-san." instead of her usual "-shi" suffix.
[FI] Since it's her benefactor, she's special.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Good to meet-cha, Kyousuke-kun♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Same here, nice to meet you.
[FI] Kurusu Kanata-chan, huh.
[FI] Hmm, somehow that name sounds familiar.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Um, is it fine if I call you Kurusu-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] It's okay to be more casual~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Then... Kanata-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] That's fine, sure... but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Could you call me, Kanakana-chan?
[FI] ...What's with this deja vu.
[FI] I know I've heard this line from someone before.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi, Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh? What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] She's our senior, older even.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh? Who is?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kanata-san is older than you, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...W-What did you say?

[FI] In a panic, I look again at Kanata-chan, I mean 
Kanata-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Hihi, I got exposed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...For real? You're older?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Yo. I'm a working adult, despite my appearance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...I can't picture that at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Uhihihi-, I look way younger than I actually am.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] I wonder if I could pass for a high schooler?
[FI] You mean an elementary schooler.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Um, Kanata-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] What is it, Kyousuke-kun?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You're Saori's benefactor, the person who gave her 
those glasses, is what I've heard but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
[FI] Benefactor...? Ahaha, I haven't done anything of that 
sort though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] I just hang out with her, like I normally do.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Which to me, was worth more than I can payback 
in a lifetime.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Just as always, you exaggerate too much.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Not at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Since the beginning when I formed the "Otaku Girls 
Unite" circle, till now.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Kanata-san, you were the one who gave me the 
push to start it all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] ...S-So I did do something, huh.

[FI] It wasn't out of modesty, but Kanata-san really 
became flustered.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah, it gave me a great amount of strong and 
stern encouragement.
[FI] But to Saori, it was definitely a life-changing event.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
[FI] Heh~, really~, ahahaha♪ Oh my~, I must have 
been amazing back then!

[FI] "Crap! I don't remember at all!" is written all over 
her face.
[FI] She certainly seems like that kind of person.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: [FI] Now then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
[FI] We have plenty to talk about, and Kyousuke-kun is 
here too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
[FI] And besides, I pretty much forgotten all about 
what happened.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Let's bring the past back up then.
